name: AlgMap-15.6
questiontext:
Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\), from the following expressions. Give your answer as a set containing the pairs of points which satisfy the equation, e.g.  \(\left( \left\{[x_1, y_1],[x_2, y_2] \right\}\right)\):
\[ \left. \begin{array}{rcl} {{CT:0}} &=&{{CT:1}} \\ {{CT:2}} &=&{{CT:3}} \end{array} \right\} \]
\([x,y] \in \) [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback: By rearranging the linear equation, \({{CT:2}} = {{CT:3}} \) we obtain: \[ y = {{CT:4}}, \] which we can substitute into the quadratic to give: \[ {{CT:5}} = {{CT:1}}. \] This can be rearranged into the more familiar quadratic form: \[ {{CT:6}} = 0. \] Solving this gives \( x = 3\) or \(x = -1 \). By substituting these back into the linear equation you can find the corresponding values of y. ( \(y = -1\) and \(y = 3\) respectively). Therefore, the solution set is: \[ (x,y) \in \left\{ [3,-1] , [-1,3] \right\}. \]
